description: This Java source file defines the RetrieveConnectionMetrics class, which represents a command to retrieve metrics and status information for a specific connection within a connectivity framework. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and handles serialization of its payload. The class is part of a command/query system for connectivity, specifically for retrieving metrics of a connection.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionMetrics
classes.description: A command class for retrieving current metrics and status information for a specific connection identified by ConnectionId.
